name: 54452 · Merrill, WI
findings: ZIP 54452 (Merrill) has 80 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 31 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 54452 (Merrill) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
46% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 54452 (Merrill) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 66% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 60% of all organizations here have no identified type.
